prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a raster visual exploration for an educational project, NOT documentation of an actual textile. Input image: original code-drawn teaching composition, used as the composition reference. Transform the attached flat blue-and-white geometry into a contemporary digitally imagined indigo textile artwork viewed perfectly flat from directly above. Preserve the square format, single central concentric ring, exactly EIGHT separate satellite concentric rings around the center, the eight inward leaf-like connectors, circular dotted perimeter, and thin square border. Introduce subtle cotton weave and soft organic dye-like edges, with rich indigo-blue and warm white only. No text, no labels, no hands, no objects, no scene, no extra motifs. This is an original teaching visualization inspired by resist-dye visual qualities; do not imply a traditional Bai pattern reconstruction or physically achievable dye result. Keep all ring centers and the radial layout from the input; make the small grain restrained enough that the eight rings remain easy to count.
observation: 可见八个外围圆环、中心圆环、边框与点列；生成图加入明显织纹和柔化边缘。纹理对比偏强，拟仅降低织纹对比后再次检查。
decisionByAssistant: 保留第一轮原图作为过程记录，发起单项修改；用户尚未选稿。
limits: AI视觉样例，不是实际织物或工艺预测；提示词可重复运行不保证逐像素相同。

author_review.basis: 用户明确选择第一轮：织纹明显，质感更强。
author_review.scope: 主要视觉选择；未评价教学效果或工艺可行性
